# YourGP

> A group of four GP-led general practices in Canberra, ACT, plus dedicated skin cancer and vasectomy services. Vision: genuine care, clinical excellence.

YourGP is owned by Dr John Deery and Dr Mel Deery. The group operates four general practices across Canberra and two sub-branded services. This site (ygp.au) is the group site: it covers who YourGP is, lists the practices, and carries recruitment information for doctors. Patient bookings, fees, opening hours and doctor profiles live on each individual practice site.

## Key Information

- **Group site**: https://ygp.au
- **Main phone**: (02) 6109 0000 (Crace, Denman Prospect, Lyneham)
- **Garema Place phone**: (02) 6257 1000
- **General enquiries**: admin@ygp.au
- **GP recruitment enquiries**: dr.john.deery@ygp.au
- **Scale**: 4 clinics, 40+ consulting rooms, 40,000+ patients per year
- **DPA status**: Crace and Denman Prospect are in a Distribution Priority Area. Lyneham and Garema Place are not.

## Dedicated Services

### YourSkin CBR
Skin cancer medicine at Crace and Denman Prospect. Doctors hold masters degrees in skin medicine or advanced diplomas from an Australian skin cancer college. FotoFinder total body imaging available.
- **Site**: https://yourskincbr.com.au

### Canberra Vasectomy
No-scalpel vasectomy service for Canberra and surrounds.
- **Phone**: (02) 6103 0434
- **Site**: https://canberravasectomy.com.au

## How YourGP Works

- **Values**: Caring, Excellence, Kaizen (continuous improvement)
- **Model**: GPs are tenants receiving service and facilities, not employees being managed
- **Four sequential pillars**: Team Excellence, GP Service Excellence, Patient Experience, Sustainable Enterprise
- **Billing**: Predominantly private billing (around 90% of consultations). DNA (did-not-attend) rate 1.25% across the group, and 0.25% at Garema Place, against 5–7% at a typical bulk-billing clinic.

## For Doctors

- **GP meetings**: The group meets as a body of doctors every two months to discuss clinical matters and practice operations
- **GP feedback**: Satisfaction surveyed formally every four months against a published target (GP NPS > 80), with informal feedback sought continuously between surveys
- **Social**: Christmas party, mid-year party, and a YourGP tennis meet-up through the year
- **Visa sponsorship**: Available for eligible international medical graduates at the two DPA clinics
- **Express interest**: Microsoft Form linked from every page of ygp.au
- **Note**: Detailed remuneration information (service fee split, expected earnings) is provided in the information pack on request, not published on the site.
